items.detail: FRED observations dated Oct 15: effective fed funds 3.88%, 2Y 4.77%, 10Y 5.10%. The 2s10s spread is +33 bp, narrowed ~20 bp over 60 days as the 2Y rose 58 bp against 38 bp for the 10Y. The 10Y is off its Oct 5 peak of 5.31% but remains a standing headwind for growth multiples. SOFR exceeds fed funds by 1 bp: no funding stress.
items.title: Rates: 10Y 5.10%, curve flattened ~20 bp over 60 days, funding calm

items.detail: Kpler ship-tracking puts Strait of Hormuz flows at 11.62M barrels per day vs a 17.15M baseline. IEA sees diesel inventories unlikely to rebuild before H2 2027. EIA's −8.6M barrel crude draw was driven substantially by the fading Gulf hurricane disruption and low imports, not clean demand evidence. WASDE was bearish corn (ending stocks 1.849B bushels vs ~1.677B expected); wheat's Black Sea export logistics are the live two-sided variable.
